messages.content: You are an experienced requirements engineer.

Classify the software requirement below into exactly one of these categories:
A. Functional: a behaviour or function that the system must perform for its users or other systems.
B. Availability: when the system must be available and how much downtime is acceptable.
C. Fault tolerance: how the system must keep working, or recover, when failures or errors occur.
D. Legal: compliance with laws, regulations, standards, licences or contracts.
E. Look and feel: the appearance, style and visual design of the user interface.
F. Maintainability: how easily the system can be corrected, changed, updated or extended.
G. Operational: the operating environment, platforms, hardware or other systems the system must run in or work with.
H. Performance: speed, response time, throughput, capacity or use of resources.
I. Portability: the ability to run on, or be moved to, different platforms or environments.
J. Scalability: the ability to handle growth in users, data or load without loss of service.
K. Security: protection against unauthorised access, use or change; authentication, privacy and auditing.
L. Usability: how easy the system is to learn and use, and how efficient and satisfying it is for users.

Requirement: "The system shall refresh the display every 60 seconds."
